title: ScreenEnvelope
description: The one shape for any screen's content (contract/README.md). `data` stays raw JSON; the screen registry decodes it into the screen's own model.

key.description: The screen key, mapped to a native screen by the screen registry.

data.description: Everything the screen needs, described by its screen key in contract/screens.

toolbar.description: Buttons for the screen's bar, in order, only those the caller may use. Absent means none.
